summary.text: Margaret Spear is the Democratic candidate for the Georgia House of Representatives, District 3, in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Republican Mitchell Horner.
She is chief of staff at a civil engineering firm and says she is running to give District 3 practical, accountable representation.

paragraphs.text: Spear graduated from Bloomington High School North and earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Washington in 2009.
Ballotpedia lists her career experience as working as a chief of staff, and in a Ballotpedia survey she said she holds that role at a local civil engineering firm.

Spear said in the survey that she is running because she wants District 3 represented by someone focused on the everyday realities of local families, noting that no Democrat had challenged the Republican party in Catoosa County for 18 years.
She described herself as a neighbor and problem-solver who wants to bring what she called thoughtful, steady leadership to Atlanta.
